d:
Sri Rama Rajyam Tamil Movie Songs, Kaatru Vaanam Song HD, featuring Balakrishna and Nayanthara. Music by Ilayaraja and directed by Bapu. Sri Ramarajyam stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Srikanth, KR Vijaya and Roja in pivotal roles.
Song : Kaatru Vaanam
Singer : SP Balasubrahmanyam
Sri Ramarajyam movie also stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Srikanth, K R Vijaya, Roja, Murali Mohan, Master Gaurav and Master Dhanush Kumar among others. The devotional film is produced by Yalamanchili Sai Babu and is dubbed from the Telugu movie of the same name.
